beats.context: Facebook's cash offer to buy Snapchat outright, November 2013; rejected.

beats.note: Evan Spiegel turned down the offer anyway, betting on growth.

beats.lead: The popular version adds a rival bid
beats.text: A rumoured $4 billion Google offer is often repeated as fact.
beats.note: It traces to a single journalist's tweet, never confirmed by Google or a named primary source; Forbes flagged the $3B-vs-$4B confusion as unresolved at the time.
Snapchat's daily photos and messages grew from 200 million to 350 million between June and September 2013 alone.

beats.name: Evan Spiegel
beats.role: Explained the decision on the Diary of a CEO podcast: 'we decided that we would rather go it alone.'

beats.line: Snap went public in 2017, valued at nearly $24 billion.
